# M3 slide numbers (generated by `python -m kaafu.m3_figures`)

Every number: Wednesday CFN timetable, Malé jetty assumed Jetty NO5. "Within 2 h" is averaged over every daytime departure (06:00-18:00): the chance that someone who needs a hospital at a random daytime moment gets there in time. Island times are the daytime median. "With speedboats" = observed FollowMe boat movements, Aug 2025, not a published schedule.

## Within 2 h of a hospital

| | HDX car-only | Public ferries only | With observed speedboats |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kaafu, nearest hospital | 77.4% | 2.4% | 22.6% |
| All 23 islands, any hospital (HDX: Maldives) | 45.9% | 17.7% | 30.1% |
| Kaafu, Greater Malé hospital | | 2.4% | 22.6% |
| All 23 islands, Greater Malé hospital | | 1.4% | 13.7% |
